Abbreviation Test
Count: 16  Wall: 1  Level: Beginner

S1: SIDES, EIGHTHS, STRUT
1 - 2 Step R to right. Step L beside R.
3 - 4 Step RF right. Step LF beside RF.
5,6 Step forward on right toe (1), Drop heel taking weight (2)
7,8 Step L forward, Turn 1/2 R

S2: EIGHTH TURNS, WALKS
1-2 Step 1/8 turn right on r. Walk forward l.
3-4 Walk r. Walk l.
5-6 Rock R to R. Recover on L.
7-8 Cross rock right over left, recover on left with 3/8 turn right
